title: One stack, not three silos: How Stelcore’s leaders want Indian brands to go global
summary: At TechSparks 2026, Stelcore’s Bharat Mandot, Percy Avari and Navin Mistry explained how brands can turn compliance, tech and supply chain into one growth engine.
llm_summary: At TechSparks 2026, Stelcore executives Bharat Mandot, Percy Avari, and Navin Mistry urged Indian brands to break down the traditional “three‑silo” approach—separating compliance, technology and supply‑chain functions—and instead fuse them into a single, coordinated growth engine.
